_doc: Written by adapters/godot_enemy_config.py; every key is documented in templates/enemy.json. Regenerate when the .tres is retuned; edit the brief and encounter blocks by hand.
name: drone
teaches: Vertical threat, and the ranged verb. It hovers above melee reach and lobs slow, dodgeable shots; the answer is to aim up. Mechanical: Breach drops it out of the air.

Track.note: holds hover_height above and hover_standoff beside the player, on the side it is already on

Aim.note: still and lit; faces the player through the tell; the shot goes where the player is when the tell ends

Stagger.entered_by: a hit at or over stagger_threshold, from any state but Stunned and Dead

Stunned.entered_by: Breach, from any state but Dead; falls; hits do not end it

transitions: player lost, or farther than give_up_range from home
player within fire_range and the fire cooldown is over
stagger_time elapsed and the player is within detection_range
a single hit at or over stagger_threshold
the stun ends and the player is within detection_range

brief.look: A flattened steel disc the width of a dinner plate with a single red lens on its underside rim, a rotor ring on top that reads as a blur in flight, and a short gun barrel under the lens. A cyan status ring around the body: VESTA infrastructure, working as intended. Dents and a scorched patch on the shell. When it aims, the lens brightens and the body tilts toward the target. Stunned, the rotor stops and it drops nose-first.
brief.silhouette: A disc with a rotor above and a lens below. Nothing else in the roster is horizontal.

encounter.notes: First met on the roof with two of them over three Scavs. The puzzle is reaching it; the zipgun is the intended answer and the roof is open sky.
